claims.text: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney stated that trade talks between the US and Canada collapsed late on Friday.
Mark Carney called the new US tariffs on Canada a "miscalculation" designed to "hurt and divide us".
Mark Carney announced Canada would match US tariffs "dollar-for-dollar" starting 8 September.
Canada's retaliatory tariffs starting September 8 will include levies on steel, dairy, appliances, and electronics.
The US imposed new 50% tariffs on a range of Canadian goods after trade talks broke down.
The new 50% US tariffs cover about $20bn of Canadian imports, representing roughly 5% of total Canadian exports to the US.
The newly targeted Canadian goods under US tariffs include wine, dairy, cement, clothing, and hockey equipment.
Existing US tariffs on Canada already applied to steel, aluminium, automobiles, and lumber.
US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer stated on Fox News that there were no plans to resume trade negotiations with Canada.
Ontario Premier Doug Ford backed Carney's stance and stated US President Donald Trump "can't be trusted".
British Columbia Premier David Eby stated that US demands for trade restrictions would reduce Canada "to the economic equivalent of the 51st state."
The USMCA trade pact underpins $1.6tn in annual trilateral trade between Canada, the US, and Mexico.
The new US tariffs on Canadian imports came into force at 12:01 am on Saturday.
US President Donald Trump announced the latest tariffs to offset what he claimed was Canadian discrimination against American cars, dairy products, and alcohol.
Canadian whisky brands potentially affected by the new US duties include Crown Royal, Canadian Club, and Black Velvet.
Several Canadian provinces removed US-made alcoholic drinks from store shelves last year after Trump introduced an initial round of tariffs.
Mark Carney stated he suspended negotiations and ordered Canada's negotiating team to return to Ottawa following last-minute changes to the US proposal.
US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer accused Canada of causing the collapse by declining to finalise a deal despite receiving favourable terms.
The US and Canada traded $880bn worth of goods and services last year.
US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer stated on Fox & Friends Weekend that the US was prepared to cut tariffs on steel, autos, and lumber as part of the proposed agreement.
Russian President Vladimir Putin stated in an interview with Vesti that Ukraine opened "Pandora's box" by targeting Russia's economy.
Vladimir Putin threatened to target Ukraine's most vulnerable economic sectors in response to Ukrainian strikes on Russian infrastructure.
Vladimir Putin rejected peace proposals for the war in Ukraine, describing them as "strange" and "unacceptable".
Ukrainian drones struck an industrial facility and an Ozon logistics centre in Chapayevsk in Russia's Samara region overnight.
Ozon is Russia's second-largest online retailer.
Russia's Defence Ministry reported shooting down 457 Ukrainian drones overnight.
A Coalition of the Willing meeting is scheduled to take place in Kyiv on Monday to support Ukraine on its Independence Day.
The Coalition of the Willing meeting will be co-chaired by French President Emmanuel Macron, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, and British Prime Minister Andy Burnham.
The death toll from the Friday drone attack on a shopping centre in Kryvyi Rih, Ukraine, rose to 16 after another body was recovered overnight.
Oleksandr Hanzha stated 130 people were injured in the double-tap drone strike on the Kryvyi Rih shopping centre.
Ukraine's defence ministry reported in June that its interception rate for ballistic missiles is approximately 40%.
A Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv killed 17 people and injured over 40 a day before the Kryvyi Rih strike.
Krasnodar Governor Veniamin Kondratyev stated a Ukrainian drone strike killed two children and injured two adults in a port town in southern Russia.
Belgorod acting Governor Aleksandr Shuvaev reported two people were killed and 13 injured in Ukrainian strikes and shelling in the Belgorod region.
EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas described the Kryvyi Rih attack as "terror by design" and proposed far-reaching new sanctions against Russia.
Ukrainian Interior Minister Ivan Vygivsky stated four people, including three children, were killed in a Russian strike in the Mykolaiv region.
US Special Envoy for Syria Tom Barrack criticized an Israeli attack on a disused military air base in Syria as an "unnecessary escalation".
Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz stated Israel provided intelligence information to authorized US parties prior to the Tuesday strike on the Syrian air base.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu claimed Turkey was seeking to establish a military presence at the disused Syrian air base.
Turkey announced it is seeking an Interpol red notice for Benjamin Netanyahu over genocide allegations related to a Gaza-bound aid flotilla.
Tom Barrack stated that Israel provided no prior warning before executing military strikes on the Abu Duhur air base in Syria.
The first Trump administration officially recognized Israel's annexation of the Golan Heights in 2019.
Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani stated Turkish military personnel visited the Abu Duhur base for ongoing training cooperation, not to establish a military base.
Syria's interim President Ahmed al-Sharaa reaffirmed that his government is not seeking conflict with Israel.
An Israeli drone strike targeted a small delivery truck near Beit Jinn in southwestern Syria, injuring a civilian driver.
The Israeli military stated its strike in southern Syria targeted a terrorist preparing immediate terror attacks.
Qatar's Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a statement condemning the Israeli drone strike as a violation of Syrian sovereignty.
A late November Israeli ground raid in Beit Jinn resulted in the deaths of 13 civilians and injured six Israeli soldiers.
US District Judge Jeannette Vargas struck down a Trump administration policy suspending immigrant visa processing for nationals from 75 countries.
Judge Jeannette Vargas ruled that Secretary of State Marco Rubio exceeded his statutory authority in issuing the visa ban.
The suspended visa processing policy, enacted in January, applied to nationals of countries including Afghanistan, Brazil, Egypt, Iran, Iraq, Nigeria, Somalia, Thailand, and Yemen.
Judge Jeannette Vargas was appointed to the federal judiciary by former President Joe Biden.
The lawsuit challenging the 75-country visa ban was filed by two non-profit organisations, including CLINIC, alongside 11 individual plaintiffs.
The State Department cited data from the Council of Economic Advisers showing over 30 percent of households with immigrants from the 75 targeted countries received public assistance.
In June, a federal judge overturned a separate Trump administration policy restricting asylum, work permits, green cards, and citizenship applications.
The US government retains the right to appeal Judge Jeannette Vargas's ruling.
BJP president Nitin Nabin held his first meeting with the newly appointed national office-bearers on August 22, 2026.
The BJP passed a 10-point resolution condemning the Congress Working Committee's decision to restrict the singing of Vande Mataram to its first two stanzas.
Parliament enacted the Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Act in 2026, granting Vande Mataram statutory protection equal to the National Anthem.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the new BJP organisational team and urged them to intensify outreach to youth.
The BJP announced a month-long 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' campaign scheduled from September 17 to October 17.
Congress MP KC Venugopal stated the party remains committed to its 1937 decision regarding Vande Mataram made by Mahatma Gandhi, Jawaharlal Nehru, and Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
The BJP's newly named national team under president Nitin Nabin consists of 65 members, including 51 new faces.
Vasundhara Raje Scindia and Ram Madhav were appointed national vice presidents of the BJP.
Smriti Irani was appointed as one of the BJP's eight national general secretaries.
Piyush Goyal was reappointed as national treasurer of the BJP.
The BJP's new 65-member national leadership team includes 12 women and six leaders from minority communities.
Nitin Nabin instructed the new BJP team to focus on "Yuva Samvad" initiatives targeted at people aged 14 and above.
A Panama-flagged cargo ship with 24 crew members sank in the Bay of Bengal about 240 nautical miles off the Paradip coast in Odisha on August 22, 2026.
The vessel was transporting iron ore from Odisha to Singapore when it went down.
The Indian Coast Guard and Indian Navy launched a search and rescue operation for the crew, most of whom were Chinese.
A senior IPS officer informed PTI that two crew members had been rescued from the water.
The vessel MV Oceanwinner departed Paradip port at 10:30 p.m. on August 20 carrying 1,700 tonnes of iron ore fines bound for China.
The 24 crew members aboard the vessel comprise 20 Chinese nationals, one Bangladeshi national, and three Myanmar nationals.
Indian Coast Guard DIG Sanjay Negi stated the search and rescue operations are being conducted by the Andaman and Nicobar unit.
